responsibility: Implements ARM’s common target hook layer for option defaults, exception-unwind policy, and driver/backend coordination around architecture selection. Besides setting ARM optimization defaults and choosing the unwind-table model, it contains the string canonicalization and rewriting helpers that normalize -mcpu and -march forms for assembler consumption, filter or sort extension suffixes, derive linker --be8 behavior, and synthesize an automatic -mfpu setting from the selected architecture and ISA feature bitmaps.
